SPOTLIGHT
Putting imperfect produce to use 
GOOGLE ENVIRONMENTAL REPORT
column2:
Google purchases healthy, nutritious fruits and vegetables 
that might otherwise go to waste because of stringent 
cosmetic requirements. Our imperfect produce initiative  
in our Bay Area headquarters has saved 150,000 kilograms 
(330,000 pounds) of produce, while making better use of  
the water, energy, and other natural resources that went  
into growing and transporting all that food.
CREATING SUSTAINABLE WORKPLACES
